# Aeoden

> Aeoden is a free AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) tool. Enter a URL and it checks how well AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity can read the site, scores it on an AEO Card, and generates ready-to-install AI files written from the site's own content: llms.txt, Organization and WebSite structured data, robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, and an ai-catalog.json for sites that offer agent resources. It gives a diagnostic score, not a guarantee of rankings or citations.

## Key pages

- [Homepage and checker](https://aeoden.com/): enter a URL, get an AEO Card and your AI files
- [Methodology](https://aeoden.com/methodology/): every check, the 75/25 page readiness and AI familiarity blend, and how AI files are generated
- [What is AEO?](https://aeoden.com/what-is-aeo/): Answer Engine Optimization explained
- [AEO vs SEO](https://aeoden.com/aeo-vs-seo/): where the emphasis shifts
- [ChatGPT search readiness](https://aeoden.com/chatgpt-search/): which OpenAI crawlers matter and what gets quoted
- [What is llms.txt?](https://aeoden.com/llms-txt/): the convention, what it does and doesn't do

## Optional

- [Sources](https://aeoden.com/sources/): crawler documentation, standards and research behind the checks
- [About](https://aeoden.com/about/): who runs it, how the AeodenBot crawler behaves, contact
- [Privacy](https://aeoden.com/privacy/): what is sent, kept, and for how long
- [AI catalog](https://aeoden.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
